GROWW WEEKLY PRODUCT PULSE — WEEK ENDING 11 OCT 2026
Based on 2,358 Play Store reviews, 2026-07-21 to 2026-10-11.

TOP THEMES
Trend: 1–2★ reviews, previous 4 weeks → last 4 weeks.
1. Customer Support & Trust — 291 complaints (↑ 90 → 111). Support feels fully automated, lacking human assistance, eroding trust and prompting uninstalls.
2. App Performance — 254 complaints (↑ 65 → 95). App crashes and long lag, especially chart loading delays after recent update, hinder reliable trading.
3. Fees and Brokerage — 107 complaints (↑ 29 → 34). Charges appear high and hidden, with unclear triggers, driving complaints about fee transparency.

WHAT USERS SAY
    "…I've attempted to contact them through both messages and calls, but all interactions are automated with no genuine human connection or assistance…" — 1★, Customer Support & Trust
    "…lots of lagging like 15-20 second I have to wait every time for loading the charts for last month…" — 1★, App Performance
    "overall good but too many charges 😔 1 buy + sell order (fno) cause me 92. brokerage 40 and external charges 50😅" — 2★, Fees and Brokerage

KEY OBSERVATION
Complaints are rising across support, performance, and fee clarity, with each area showing increasing negative sentiment over recent weeks.

ACTION IDEAS
1. Provide live human agents for inquiries that currently receive only automated replies.
2. Optimize chart rendering to eliminate long loading delays reported after the recent update.
3. Clarify each charge trigger in the UI, explaining why fees are applied beyond brokerage.

===== Review Pulse entry — week ending 11 Oct 2026 =====

DATE:
2026-10-16

TOP THEMES:
Customer Support & Trust, App Performance, Fees and Brokerage

WEEKLY PULSE:
GROWW WEEKLY PRODUCT PULSE — WEEK ENDING 11 OCT 2026
Based on 2,358 Play Store reviews, 2026-07-21 to 2026-10-11.

TOP THEMES
Trend: 1–2★ reviews, previous 4 weeks → last 4 weeks.
1. Customer Support & Trust — 291 complaints (↑ 90 → 111). Support feels fully automated, lacking human assistance, eroding trust and prompting uninstalls.
2. App Performance — 254 complaints (↑ 65 → 95). App crashes and long lag, especially chart loading delays after recent update, hinder reliable trading.
3. Fees and Brokerage — 107 complaints (↑ 29 → 34). Charges appear high and hidden, with unclear triggers, driving complaints about fee transparency.

WHAT USERS SAY
    "…I've attempted to contact them through both messages and calls, but all interactions are automated with no genuine human connection or assistance…" — 1★, Customer Support & Trust
    "…lots of lagging like 15-20 second I have to wait every time for loading the charts for last month…" — 1★, App Performance
    "overall good but too many charges 😔 1 buy + sell order (fno) cause me 92. brokerage 40 and external charges 50😅" — 2★, Fees and Brokerage

KEY OBSERVATION
Complaints are rising across support, performance, and fee clarity, with each area showing increasing negative sentiment over recent weeks.

ACTION IDEAS
1. Provide live human agents for inquiries that currently receive only automated replies.
2. Optimize chart rendering to eliminate long loading delays reported after the recent update.
3. Clarify each charge trigger in the UI, explaining why fees are applied beyond brokerage.

IDENTIFIED FEE ISSUE:
Charges beyond brokerage seen as hidden — top confusion pattern: other charges seen as hidden (taxes, DP, exchange) (7 of 14 confused reviews); a further 175 reviews say charges are too high.

EXPLANATION BULLETS:
- Equity trades charge brokerage per executed order, the lower of ₹20 or 0.1% with a ₹5 minimum. Futures & Options charge ₹20 per executed order.
- When you sell shares, a DP charge applies per transaction, consisting of the depository fee and Groww’s fee.
- STT, stamp duty, exchange transaction charges, SEBI turnover charge and IPFT are regulatory/statutory charges levied by the exchange, not by Groww.
- An 18% GST is added on brokerage, DP charges, exchange transaction charges, IPFT and SEBI turnover charges.
- The overall trade cost includes brokerage plus DP, regulatory, statutory and GST charges, so it may exceed brokerage alone.

Why is my total charge more than brokerage?

  • Equity trades charge brokerage per executed order, the lower of ₹20 or 0.1% with a ₹5 minimum. Futures & Options charge ₹20 per executed order.
  • When you sell shares, a DP charge applies per transaction, consisting of the depository fee and Groww’s fee.
  • STT, stamp duty, exchange transaction charges, SEBI turnover charge and IPFT are regulatory/statutory charges levied by the exchange, not by Groww.
  • An 18% GST is added on brokerage, DP charges, exchange transaction charges, IPFT and SEBI turnover charges.
  • The overall trade cost includes brokerage plus DP, regulatory, statutory and GST charges, so it may exceed brokerage alone.
